reviews.text:
On October 27th, 2024, we visited the newly opened PC Chandra showroom on Tobin Road, conveniently located near our home. The ambiance was impressive, with a warm and inviting atmosphere. The staff was exceptionally polite and attentive, especially the sales associates, who did their best to showcase a variety of ornaments despite the crowd during the Dhanteras festival. However, the stock of ornaments seemed somewhat limited, possibly due to high purchase volumes for the occasion.

We purchased a few pieces of jewelry and were delighted to receive a 22 Karat 200 mg gold coin as a gift. The showroom also offers parking facilities, which added to the convenience of our shopping experience. Overall, it was a pleasant visit with excellent service and a thoughtfully designed setup for customers.

The P.C. Chandra Jewellers store on Tobin Road looks grand and inviting! The building’s architecture has a classic charm with a clock tower on the side, creating an eye-catching display, especially at night with all the beautiful lighting. The bright sign and decorative lights give it a festive vibe, making it stand out in the busy surroundings. Founded in 1939, this jeweller has a legacy, and the store’s design reflects that heritage and prestige. It's definitely a landmark in the area and adds a touch of elegance to the neighborhood.

Service and staff are extremely professional and knowledgeable. I was not sure exactly what all to buy they really helped me figured out everything and also went out of the way to figure out billing info. Although 1 request please open 1 branch in my home town - Bilaspur. Thank everyone for your great service.

They have a unique collection of gold, silver and diamond jewellery, very aesthetic and affordable also. But the best thing about this shop is the staff behaviour, exceptionally polite and helpful. The entire process of exchange of old gold is also very transparent. Overall a great experience.
Good store at proper location, parking available and good collection of gold. Good behaviour of sales team.
Nice experience. Behavior of all staff is very polite and good.
